verdict.rationale: LibreChat's documentation has a dedicated 'Subagents' feature page, which indicates a first-party multi-agent capability. The pack gives only the page title, with nothing on how subagents split, delegate, or parallelize work. missing for 10: description of subagent delegation and orchestration behavior, evidence of parallel execution, any swarm or agent-to-agent protocol support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work
